name: atlassian.com
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 162 structured data items miss a property Google expects.
lesson: Fill the required properties of each JSON-LD type, then test it in the Rich Results Test.
summary: The start page is larger than 2 MB, so the review read its first 2 MB. www.atlassian.com scores 68 out of 100 (D). 5 checks fail now, 26 are at risk, and 26 pass. Fix first: 48 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 48 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /software/bitbucket/features/pipelines, /software/customer-service-management, /software/talent, /software/jira-align and 31 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: OneTrust was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw cookies ajs_anonymous_id, atl_xid.xc on atl-paas.net.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: 162 structured data items miss a property Google expects
fix.evidence: / SoftwareApplication lacks offers or aggregateRating, / SoftwareApplication lacks offers or aggregateRating, / SoftwareApplication lacks offers or aggregateRating and 159 more.
fix.fix: Fill the missing properties so the item qualifies for rich results.

fix.title: 150 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 95 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 95 pages analyzed.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The layout holds still while loading
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
